description: Use when the user asks for the current public DNS records of a name, e.g. to confirm a change. Returns A, AAAA, CNAME, MX, NS, TXT, SOA, CAA or SRV records with TTL and the resolver that answered. No PTR (reverse DNS) lookups. Ex: 'Show the TXT records of example.com'. Free trial without an API key: a few calls a day.

name.description: The DNS name to look up, e.g. _dmarc.example.com.

types.description: Optional record types, comma-separated: A, AAAA, CNAME, MX, NS, TXT, SOA, CAA, SRV (default A).

name: dns_lookup
title: DNS lookup
